kind: analysis: a fingerprint phase and a compare phase per host, then a local reduction; no search
kind_note: Steps 4 (pooled strength) and 5 (fingerprints and ball radii) of experiments/2026-10-06-fretish-rerun/PLAN.md, run through the queue as one declaration. Not seed-split: each host takes whole subjects from subjects-<host>.txt. (PLAN.md; campaign.toml.)
close_note: A bookkeeping close. Nothing under out/ or members/ was recomputed or edited at the close, and every figure here is copied from the file named beside it.

source_campaign.name: 2026-10-06-fretish-rerun
source_campaign.input: The rerun's accumulated/maximal.tsv members, pooled once locally by scripts/pool_members.py from counter-wt/fretish-rerun/experiments/results-fretish-rerun and committed as members/<subject>.jsonl.gz; members/index.csv gives the counts and each file's SHA-256. (PLAN.md, Inputs.)

decision_rule: None registered. This campaign's PLAN.md pre-registers no decision rule. The source campaign's PLAN.md (Endpoints and tests) names the test only: strength is the pooled net subsumption share and diversity the ball-radii containment at K = 3, each tested by the exact Wilcoxon signed-rank test over subjects. Its one decision rule, McNemar on found at the cap, belongs to the search and was fired in that archive.
decision_rule_firing: No rule to fire. The registered tests read as follows. Strength (out/strength/summary.txt): net_decided n=17, median -0.1138, mean -0.1618, u>d 0, d>u 17, tie 0, Wilcoxon p=1.526e-05; net_imp and net_non give the same counts and p. Ball radii at K = 3 (out/ball-radii/hl_j3m.txt): Net BinA - AinB n=15, zeros 1, mean -0.096, HL -0.039 [-0.089, -0.005], p 0.035; BinA - ctrl A n=14, HL -0.031 [-0.062, -0.003], p 0.033; AinB - ctrl B n=15, HL +0.007 [-0.028, +0.043], p 0.81. A is directed and B is uniform.

fingerprint.errors: No draw.log on any host holds the string ERROR (grep -c reads 0 for all 17 subjects) and every ltl.err is empty. The count of draws that hit the 30 s black timeout is not recorded in any summary file.
